# AI action montage on Kling 4 — 30-second BMX, dance and chase takes

**Three or four key stills and a one-line prompt become a 30-second Kling 4 trick, dance or chase montage with a crash ending.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_0c3e08ead522.webp" alt="A low fisheye shot follows a skateboarder in a red beanie bombing down a cobbled Lisbon street past a yellow tram." width="480"></p>

Turn three or four key frames into a 30-second action montage with Kling 4 (kling_v4): a breakdance battle, BMX or skate tricks, a scooter or bike chase through traffic, parkour or a sports highlight, with a crash or punchline at the end. A one-line prompt over strong stills, "no slow motion", the trick names, the end state as the last still, and how to pick the usable seconds. Includes a tested varg call with the reference route pinned. Use when someone wants an AI action montage, a dance or trick sequence, an extreme sports clip, a chase, a "fail" ending, or fast-cut energy in one Kling 4 generation. For a full story use kling-4-keyframe-film; for prompt rules use kling-4-prompting.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill kling-4-action-montage                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills kling-4-action-montage --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 30-second BMX montage on Kling 4 from the 4 stills in ./stills/, tail whip and bar spin, crash at the end, 9:16"
- "Breakdance battle in a park ring starring my character ./dancer.png, no slow motion, 21:9"
- "Scooter chase through night traffic in one 30-second take, then cut it down to the best 10 seconds"
